about: SDK 3.0.0 speech and silence (make_speech.py holds the rules and the reference). Per case: `frames` are the greedy ids of log_probs, one per 40 ms frame (0 is blank), `timing` those of timing_log_probs, one per 20 ms frame (two per log_probs frame); a frame is active when either is non-blank on it. The take is delivered in chunks of `chunk_frames` frames (the last may be shorter); `endOnSilenceMs` is the session option (null: off); `other_heads` gives the greedy ids of further CTC heads for the token counts. `expect`: `frames_used` (the frames of the take: fewer than given when the take ended on silence), `speech` (1 or 0 per frame used), the totals in frames and seconds, `tokens` per head, `chunk_speech` per chunk delivered, and `events` in order, each with the index of the chunk that raises it.

cases.name: conformance clip Saood_001007: a madd held for 3.8 s does not end the take
cases.about: A real clip of the engine's conformance set. From 6680 ms the timing head holds one sound for 3800 ms (a madd of six counts) while log_probs shows it only now and then. Default window: one speechStarted and no speechEnded before the clip's end.

cases.name: conformance clip Saood_001007 with the smallest window, then silence
cases.about: endOnSilenceMs 500 does not end the take inside the madd either; with 40 blank frames after the clip the take ends once, 13 inactive frames after its last active frame.

cases.name: conformance clip Husary_112001: the longest pause between two tokens of the 35 clips
cases.about: A pause of 480 ms between two words: 12 inactive frames, one fewer than the smallest window needs (13). endOnSilenceMs 500 does not end the take there; it ends in the silence after the recitation.

cases.name: a take that starts in silence and ends inside the window
cases.about: 20 blank frames, a phrase, 30 blank frames. speechStarted at the first token; the take ends before the window has passed, so there is no speechEnded. Only the frames with a token are speech: no padding.

cases.name: a pause shorter than the window
cases.about: Two phrases 30 blank frames apart (1.2 s): one speechStarted, no speechEnded.

cases.name: a pause longer than the window
cases.about: Two phrases 45 blank frames apart: speechEnded is raised when the 38th inactive frame after the last token arrives, atMs at the end of the last active frame; the second phrase starts speech again.

cases.name: the window edge: 37 inactive frames after the last token
cases.about: The take ends one frame short of L + 38: no speechEnded.

cases.name: the window edge: 38 inactive frames after the last token
cases.about: The 38th inactive frame arrives in the last chunk: speechEnded.

cases.name: a held sound is speech
cases.about: A sound held for 50 frames (2 s): log_probs shows its id on one frame and blank on the other 49, the timing head holds it. Every frame of the hold is active, so no speechEnded is raised although log_probs is blank for longer than the window. Under log_probs alone this take would have ended inside the hold.

cases.name: a held sound and endOnSilenceMs 500
cases.about: The smallest window (W = 13 frames) does not end the take while the sound is held; the take ends 13 inactive frames after the hold's last frame.

cases.name: a take that ends on a held sound followed by silence ends once
cases.about: The last sound is held for 40 frames, then nobody recites. With endOnSilenceMs 1500 there is one speechEnded and one ended, 38 inactive frames after the hold's last frame, and nothing before it.

cases.name: the timing head starts before log_probs
cases.about: The timing head is non-blank from two frames before the first token of log_probs: speechStarted is at the timing head's first frame.

cases.name: the second 20 ms frame alone makes a frame active
cases.about: Only timing frame 2f + 1 is non-blank on frame f = 12: that frame is active.

cases.name: a token of log_probs with a blank timing head
cases.about: log_probs alone makes a frame active too.

cases.name: endOnSilenceMs 600: the take ends on silence
cases.about: W = 15 frames, so the take ends when the 15th inactive frame after the last token arrives. The chunk that carries that frame is the last one; the frames after it in this vector are audio that is never decoded.

cases.name: endOnSilenceMs 1000 with a 480 ms context
cases.about: W = 25, chunks of 12 frames. The trigger frame is in the middle of a chunk: the whole chunk belongs to the take and its frames count in the totals.

cases.name: endOnSilenceMs 1010 rounds up to 26 frames
cases.about: A window that is not a multiple of 40 ms is rounded up: silenceMs is 1040.

cases.name: endOnSilenceMs set and no speech
cases.about: A take of inactive frames only never ends on silence and raises no event: the window counts silence after speech.

cases.name: endOnSilenceMs set, the take is finished by the app first
cases.about: The app finishes 10 inactive frames after the last token (15 are needed): no speechEnded, no ended.

cases.name: chunk.speech is the chunk's own frames
cases.about: 160 ms chunks (4 frames). A token at the last frame of a chunk: only that chunk holds speech. The chunks before and after it do not.

cases.name: the word bar and the foreign token are tokens
cases.about: Ids 1 (the word bar) and 37 are non-blank like any other.

cases.name: tokens at the first and the last frame
cases.about: Active frames at both ends of the take.

cases.name: an empty take
cases.about: No frame at all (finished before the first chunk): zero totals, no chunk, no event.

cases.name: a take shorter than one chunk
cases.about: 5 frames with one token: one short chunk.

cases.name: tokens per head
cases.about: The default head selection has three CTC heads. inter1_log_probs (40 ms) also emits the word bar; timing_log_probs has 20 ms frames (two per log_probs frame) and holds a token for as long as it sounds. Each head counts its own runs. The frames between two tokens that the timing head fills are speech.

cases.name: three phrases, two ends
cases.about: speechStarted and speechEnded alternate: start, end, start, end, start.

cases.name: fixture take 20: the longest held vowel of the fixture does not end the take
cases.about: A real take of the fixture (index 20 of wrap/scorer_fixture/vectors.json, c16_l64, 128 frames). From frame 57 log_probs is blank for 39 frames (1.56 s) while the timing head holds the sound. Default window: one speechStarted, no speechEnded. Under log_probs alone the window of 1500 ms would have passed inside the vowel.

cases.name: fixture take 20 with the smallest window
cases.about: endOnSilenceMs 500 does not end the take inside the held vowel either; it ends 13 inactive frames after the take's last active frame.

cases.name: fixture take 20 followed by silence: the take ends 1500 ms after its last active frame
cases.about: The same take with 60 blank frames after it and endOnSilenceMs 1500: speechEnded and ended come with the chunk that carries the 38th inactive frame after the last active one, once.

cases.name: fixture take 20 cut at the end of its held vowel, then silence: it ends once
cases.about: The take's frames up to the last frame of the held sound, then 60 blank frames, endOnSilenceMs 1500: one speechStarted, one speechEnded, one ended.

cases.name: fixture take 25: the timing head alone is active again after the last token
cases.about: A real take (index 25, c16_l64, 128 frames) whose timing head is active for 14 frames 0.92 s after the last token of log_probs. Default window: the pause is shorter than the window, so one speechStarted and no speechEnded; the late frames are speech.

cases.name: fixture take 25 with the smallest window
cases.about: endOnSilenceMs 500: the take ends 13 inactive frames after its last token; the timing head's late activity is audio that is never decoded.
